Read 2026-11-07 from the table the page loads (https://www.mercantile.co.il/api/MoneyMarket/Saving?pageId=d57395d4-ba86-43b6-9a85-26a7c97a1e36, 'lastUpdatedAt' 2026-11-06T22:00, prime 4.75%; library e7d5f46d740c1df4). tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel plan (the 447 table's linkage column 'לא צמוד'): interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.
